notes.title: Version update report Ver1.02
notes.content:
Ver. 1.02 Update Contents
Fixed a bug in the W5, W6, and W7 boss battles where slow-motion would not heal if the summoned enemy went off-screen.
Fixed a bug that slow motion would not heal if the player died at the same time as the W5, W6, or W7 boss battle.

notes.title: Version update report Ver1.01
notes.content:
Ver1.01 Update Contents
Fixed a bug in which the judgment of falling to death was wrongly set to the downward direction after returning from the first half of 2-2.
Fixed a bug in the terrain in front of the 7-3 boss.
Fixed a bug that the achievements "Time Attacker," "Shrinking World," and "Nekoduru Chorus" could not be obtained.
Fixed a bug in which the vibration would not stop if you went out to the world map during the vibration performance.
Fixed a bug in the world map that caused the vibration to stop when the player exited the world map during the vibration stage.
Fixed a problem where no shells were emitted when firing the Destroyer Cannon with the barrel pointing straight up.
Fixed a problem with the spelling of the letters in the game over.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Version Update Report Ver0.33
notes.content:
Ver0.33 Update Contents
Fixed a bug where the sorting of skills by lineage was not working properly.
Fixed a bug in W5 where the sky in the background wasn't moving.
Fixed a dialogue setting error in 6-1.
Fixed a bug in W5 where the background sky wasn't moving.
Fixed hit detection of 6-1 Geron.
Fixed a bug in 6-2 where the bring skill was not working.
Adjusted the number of recovery items in 3-4, 4-2, 5-1, 5-3, and 6-4.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Version Update Report Ver0.32
notes.content:
Ver0.32 Update Contents
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to progress when riding a Gerone.
Fixed a bug that prevented you from getting achievements even if you met the requirements to get them.

notes.title: Version Update Report Ver0.31
notes.content:
Ver0.31 Update Contents
Fixed a bug that the BGM setting of some stages was wrong.
Fixed a bug where the attack detection was not functioning at the top of the screen.

notes.title: World 6 implemented!　Ver. 0.30 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221953/1d0c8ecad20de5874aaddd44ad8b8310ccf9e77b.png[/img]
We have released Ver. 0.30, which implements World 6, set on the moon, the enemy's home turf.
The main changes are as follows

Ver. 0.30
Implemented up to W6
Improved camera work.
Fixed the target time of some stages.
Slightly modified the stage structure of 2-1.
Changed some BGM.

notes.title: World 5 implemented!　Ver 0.20 update
notes.content:
Version 0.20 has been released, implementing World 5, which is set in an enemy airborne fortress.
The main changes are as follows.

●The main changes are as follows: - Ver 0.20
・Implementation to W5.
・I'm adding a lot of skills.
・Added the difference of Eyre's expression.
・Changed the direction at the start of the boss fight.
・Fixed a small bug.

notes.title: Version Update Report Ver0.12
notes.content:
Ver 0.12 Update Contents
・Implemented a difficulty setting function.
　In the new game, the first time you clear 1-1, you can play
　It's now set at an appropriate level of difficulty.
　You can also change the difficulty level from the options screen
・Implementing a bust-up graphic.
　Boss characters now have a busted-up graphic!

notes.title: Version update report
notes.content:
●The following is an update to Ver0.11
-The screen to confirm the input of cross keys is available after key configuration.
　Because some controllers have cross keys that cannot be entered diagonally.
-Increase the number of intermediate points in some stages.
-Fixed a disorder in the drawing of the HP gauge.
-Fixed a problem with lizardmen's attacks that didn't have a hit decision.
-Fixed a bug that made it possible to climb the slanted ceiling.
-Added downward shooting to the tutorial.
-Some messages have been changed and the guidance to the skill equipment screen has been increased.
-After clearing 1-1, a tutorial dialog is added.
-Adjusted the HP of the bosses in World 3 to be lower.
-New products are displayed in the shop with the NEW mark.
